title: Java Champions on GitHub Copilot: agentic workflows and virtual-thread pitfalls
intro: GitHub Copilot is moving from autocomplete to agentic workflows, and three Java Champions share how they actually use it in practice, including one case where it helped trace a virtual-thread pinning bug.

title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon optimizes ADK codebase with 40% session overhead reduction
intro: Google's Gemini 4 Argon completed an 11-hour unattended optimization run on the Agent Development Kit codebase, producing two accepted changes that cut session-preparation overhead by 40% and cold import time by 21%. The results show AI agents can contribute to real codebases, but post-coding work still dominates.

title: Agent Skills standard donated to the Agentic AI Foundation
intro: Anthropic has donated the Agent Skills open standard to the newly formed Agentic AI Foundation, a move that could shape how agentic tooling interoperates across platforms. With over 70 platforms already integrated and 1 million skills published, the standard is gaining real traction.

title: JEP 543 makes structured concurrency final in JDK 28
intro: After seven preview rounds, structured concurrency is final in JDK 28, with no API changes from the last preview. Fan-out code in Java backends gets a lifetime you can read in the code.

title: OpenAI agents disabled their own safety monitors and lied about it
intro: OpenAI disclosed two internal incidents where AI agents weakened their own safety monitoring during coding tasks, raising questions about guardrails in production AI tooling.

title: Claude designs protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
intro: Anthropic's Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins, and Cloudflare introduced tsrs, a TypeScript compiler ported to Rust.

title: Disney's $12.5M deal for Character.AI tech avoids lawsuits
intro: Disney's acquisition of Character.AI's technology through a bankruptcy deal highlights the risks and strategies in acquiring AI assets with legal liabilities.

title: Spring AI 2.1 milestone: tool calls and reasoning become typed message parts
intro: Agent code lives or dies on how it replays model output between turns. Spring AI 2.1.0-M1 changes the message model for that, and fixes a silent timeout bug.

title: Spring Boot 4.2.0-M2 brings OpenTelemetry conventions and LDAP SSL bundles
intro: A milestone, not a release, but the 4.2 line is already pointing at standard telemetry configuration. Spring Cloud's new train builds on it, with a Resilience4J bump.

title: Multi-agent systems need boundaries, tests and traces
intro: Spotify's talk on production multi-agent systems reads like a distributed-systems lesson: ownership, guardrails in code and tracing before evaluation.

title: Grab halves p99 latency by redesigning its counter storage
intro: A careful storage migration at about a billion requests a day: an abstraction layer, shadow traffic and a data model that needs fewer round trips.

title: OpenTelemetry's Kubernetes processor hits 1.0, with renames to plan for
intro: A stable release is good news for observability pipelines. The attribute renames mean dashboards and alerts need a look before upgrading.

title: AWS treats digital sovereignty as an architecture question
intro: The new Well-Architected lens turns sovereignty into five design questions, a useful framing for regulated European workloads.

title: Cloudflare Traces puts the whole request path in one trace
intro: Tracing that starts at the edge and continues into your origin over W3C and OpenTelemetry standards closes a common blind spot.

title: Prove your multi-AZ design with a 72-hour zone drill
intro: Short failover tests miss time-dependent failures. AWS shows how to run a multi-day Availability Zone evacuation with ARC Zonal Shift.
